tab.label: Display
section.window.title: Window
section.window.description: How the window fills the screen, and which screen it uses.
section.refreshRate.title: Refresh rate
section.refreshRate.description: A multiple of 60 shows every frame of 60 Hz content for the same time.
row.windowMode.label: Window mode
row.windowMode.hint: Pick how the window fills the screen. It changes right away.
row.windowMode.keywords: windowed borderless fullscreen full screen frame
row.displayMonitor.label: Screen
row.displayMonitor.hint: Pick a screen for borderless and fullscreen, or follow the screen the window is on.
row.detectedRate.label: Detected now
row.detectedRate.description: The rate the display runs at now.
row.detectedRate.hint: Measured from how fast the app draws frames, so it can read a little off the rate the display reports.
row.detectedRate.keywords: refresh rate hz fps frame rate
row.syncedRateInFullscreen.label: Synced rate in fullscreen
row.syncedRateInFullscreen.description: Switch the display to the target rate while in fullscreen, and back when fullscreen ends.
row.syncedRateInFullscreen.hint: On, fullscreen borrows the target rate and hands the old rate back when it ends. The desktop keeps its own rate.
row.syncedRateInFullscreen.keywords: refresh rate hz fullscreen sync vsync
row.syncedRateTargetHz.label: Target refresh rate
row.syncedRateTargetHz.description: The rate the synced mode and the change button use.
row.syncedRateTargetHz.hint: Pick a rate the display offers. A multiple of 60 suits content made at 60 frames a second.
row.changeRate.label: Change refresh rate
row.changeRate.description: Set the display to the target rate now and leave it there.
row.changeRate.hint: Asks first. The screen goes black for a second while it switches, and the rate stays after the app closes.
mode.windowed.label: Windowed
mode.windowed.hint: A normal window with a frame, which you can move and resize.
mode.borderless.label: Borderless
mode.borderless.hint: Fills the screen with no frame. Other windows can still come on top.
mode.fullscreen.label: Fullscreen
mode.fullscreen.hint: Takes over the screen until you leave fullscreen.
monitor.followWindow: The screen the window is on
rate.hint.multiple: A multiple of 60, so every frame of 60 Hz content stays on screen for the same time.
rate.hint.uneven: Not a multiple of 60, so 60 Hz content can stutter.
readout.warning: {hz} Hz is not a multiple of 60. Content made at 60 frames a second cannot give every frame the same time on screen, which shows as stutter when the picture scrolls.
dialog.title: Change your display to {hz} Hz?
dialog.message: This changes your display from {from} to {hz} Hz and leaves it there. The screen goes black for a second while it switches.
dialog.note.stays: The rate stays until something changes it back. Pick another rate here, or use the display settings of your operating system.
dialog.note.synced: To leave your desktop alone, cancel and turn on the synced rate in fullscreen. {name} then borrows the rate only while in fullscreen and hands it back when fullscreen ends.
dialog.note.others: Other windows can move or resize when the rate changes, and some displays take a moment to settle.
